cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought six trays when that stallholder bought six. This will pay off next market day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She runs a soup stall. We've bought six trays of tomatoes for our book stall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely, learning the food market before expanding. What will she give us for them?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half what we paid. And she offered us the empty pitch beside her next Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take it. The loss bought us a place beside the only person here who knows how to sell a tomato.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
